title: Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for Docker deployment with blue-green strategy
acceptance_criteria: CI steps: npm ci, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build
CD steps: SSH into droplet, pull latest images, docker compose up with health checks
Blue-green deployment: two compose projects (blue/green), nginx upstream switches on health
Docker Compose health checks configured for all services (app, db, nginx)
Deployment script handles rollback on health check failure
completion_summary: Rewrote .github/workflows/deploy.yml for Docker deployment: builds image, compresses, SCPs to server, loads via SSH, blue-green rotation with health check polling, nginx upstream switching, old container cleanup.
